title: Monte Carlo sampling of Ising configurations
action: For each parameter set (U=3, mu=1.5, beta ∈ {3,7,10,14} and U=8, mu=4, beta=3), run a Metropolis Monte Carlo simulation on an 18×18 square lattice with open boundaries and hopping t_bar=1. Sample Ising spin configurations {S(r)=±1} according to the correlated binary alloy distribution P({S}) ∝ det(…) using the single-particle Hamiltonian h = t̂ - (U/2)S(r) to compute configuration weights via eigenvalues. Generate L=100 uncorrelated configurations for each condition. Store the configurations in a file for the next step.
description: Monte Carlo sampling step: produce the required Ising spin configurations used as input for the DOS calculation.
output_schema: Not applicable – process step; evidence artifact contains the configuration arrays.

title: Compute and average density of states
action: For each condition and its set of stored Ising configurations, diagonalize the real-space single-particle Hamiltonian matrix h = t̂ - (U/2)S(r) (size 18×18 rows/columns) and collect all eigenvalues. Compute the DOS histogram by averaging over the 100 configurations. Output a single JSON file containing energy bins and DOS values for every condition.
description: Compute the density of states of light atoms by exact diagonalization on a lattice with Ising disorder, averaged over Monte-Carlo configurations.
